strings.sign_in_create_account: New to Stride? Create an account on the web
strings.sign_in_locked_message: You're signed in, but you aren't in an Organization. Join one, or choose the Organization plan, to review and unblock your agents' work here.
strings.sign_in_locked_title: The app is part of the Organization plan
strings.sign_in_network_error: Couldn't reach Stride. Check your connection and try again.
strings.sign_in_note: Opens a secure browser window. Your company sign-in and two-step check work as they do on the web.

strings.sign_in_point_ready: **Keep Ready full** so idle agents always have work.
strings.sign_in_point_review_face_id: **Review** what an agent finished, verdicts first, and approve with Face ID.
strings.sign_in_point_review_passcode: **Review** what an agent finished, verdicts first, and approve with your passcode.
strings.sign_in_point_review_touch_id: **Review** what an agent finished, verdicts first, and approve with Touch ID.
strings.sign_in_point_unblock: **Unblock** released tasks, expired claims and failed goal hooks.
strings.sign_in_tagline: Your agents do the work. Stride tells you when one of them is waiting on you.
strings.target_risk_slip: Finishing at the current pace would land {estimate}, after the {target_date} target. Reduce remaining work or move the target date.
